text: That mechanism of injury suggests a potential ligament or tendon injury, such as a "jammed finger" or collateral ligament sprain. Can you show me if you can fully straighten and bend the finger, and does it feel unstable or wobble side-to-side?

text: My main symptom is Progressive swelling and pain in the right ring finger. I also have Inability to flex the right ring finger at the distal interphalangeal joint when making a fist, Pain at the distal interphalangeal joint, Extended right ring finger in resting position.

speaker: Doctor
text: The inability to flex the distal interphalangeal joint after an avulsion injury strongly suggests a mallet finger. To confirm the diagnosis and rule out a bony fragment, I need to visualize the joint structure. REQUEST TEST: X-Ray_right_ring_finger
